items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He got his name, Mr. Bob Lyon.

ctx.x: For sure. He said, did you ever work again with Jim Kelly?
Again? Yeah, with him. Yeah. You mean with Jim Kelly? We went to Mexico together. But I'll tell you the way. But I should work with his next one, Ernest, with Bob Lyon. He got his name, Mr. Bob Lyon.
Let me see. Uh... Ask him how you spell this guy, L.C. Pelche's name.
